title: Study of Existence and Stability of Fixed Points of Hypotenuse Contracting Mappings with Applications to Parabolic PDE
summary: In this article, we introduce a novel class of mappings identified by their property of contracting the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle in the setting of metric spaces. We establish sufficient conditions ensuring both the existence and uniqueness of fixed points. A geometric analysis, complemented by illustrative diagrams, is provided to differentiate these mappings from other familiar contraction types, namely perimeter and area contractions, supported by examples.
